note.en: The orb comes down from the top of the frame, on one column of the picture.
note.fr: L'orbe descend du haut du cadre, sur une seule colonne de l'image.
note.es: El orbe baja desde lo alto del encuadre, por una sola columna de la imagen.
note.it: La sfera scende dall'alto del fotogramma, lungo una sola colonna dell'immagine.

note.en: It turns back as the camera does, a tenth of a second ahead of it.
note.fr: Elle repart vers le haut quand la caméra le fait, un dixième de seconde avant elle.
note.es: Vuelve a subir cuando lo hace la cámara, una décima de segundo antes.
note.it: Risale quando lo fa la camera, un decimo di secondo prima.

note.en: It slides along the dark band under the wing, towards the nose.
note.fr: Elle glisse le long de la bande sombre sous l'aile, vers le nez.
note.es: Se desliza a lo largo de la banda oscura bajo el ala, hacia el morro.
note.it: Scivola lungo la banda scura sotto l'ala, verso il muso.

note.en: It shows again above the fuselage, rising, as the shot ends.
note.fr: Elle réapparaît au-dessus du fuselage, en montant, à la fin du plan.
note.es: Reaparece sobre el fuselaje, subiendo, al final del plano.
note.it: Riappare sopra la fusoliera, salendo, alla fine della ripresa.

time.rationale: June 1976 (Patrick Gross), June or July in other sources; the day is supposed, the hour chosen for the light on the aircraft

lat.rationale: "Over southern England": the coast to the Midlands

lighting.rationale: The fuselage and the fin lit on the camera's side, the aircraft flying at 105° from the camera's heading; the aircraft's white neutral (244) and the ground in full light, which a Sun under some 15° would redden and dim

description.fr: Le Concorde de British Airways filmé depuis un Learjet par la caméra périscope Astrovision, et l'orbe qui l'accompagne. Mesurés sur le film : l'inclinaison de la caméra, le défilement du sol, le contraste, la netteté et les poussières de la copie. Ajustés sur le film : l'attitude du Concorde. Supposés : date, heure, lieu, altitude, focale, pellicule, et donc la place du Soleil. Alan Tanner, de l'équipe du film, y voit un reflet du Soleil dans le périscope.
description.en: British Airways' Concorde filmed from a Learjet through the Astrovision periscope camera, and the orb that goes with it. Measured on the film: the camera's tilt, the ground sliding by, the copy's contrast, softness and dust. Fitted on the film: the Concorde's attitude. Supposed: date, hour, place, height, lens, film stock, hence where the Sun is. Alan Tanner, of the film's crew, sees in it a reflection of the Sun in the periscope.
description.es: El Concorde de British Airways filmado desde un Learjet con la cámara periscópica Astrovision, y el orbe que lo acompaña. Medidos en la película: la inclinación de la cámara, el desfile del suelo, el contraste, la nitidez y el polvo de la copia. Ajustada en la película: la actitud del Concorde. Supuestos: fecha, hora, lugar, altitud, focal, película, y por tanto la posición del Sol. Alan Tanner, del equipo de la película, ve en él un reflejo del Sol en el periscopio.
description.it: Il Concorde di British Airways filmato da un Learjet con la cinepresa a periscopio Astrovision, e la sfera che lo accompagna. Misurati sul film: l'inclinazione della camera, lo scorrere del suolo, il contrasto, la nitidezza e la polvere della copia. Adattato sul film: l'assetto del Concorde. Supposti: data, ora, luogo, altitudine, focale, pellicola, e quindi la posizione del Sole. Alan Tanner, della troupe del film, vi vede un riflesso del Sole nel periscopio.

relativeHumidity.rationale: A humid summer afternoon over southern England; no record of the day, whose date is itself supposed

visibilityKm.rationale: From the film: the haze that leaves the ground under the aircraft (5 km off) as detailed as the film shows it. The film loses the farther ground faster than any haze can, which is put down to its copy (a 480-line television transfer), not to the air
